articles.title: Jarren Duran: ‘I thought I was going to be released’ by Red Sox
articles.description:
"I hate looking at the numbers but when you’re going bad, you look at the numbers and it was pretty obvious how bad I was."

summary: Jarren Duran expressed concerns about being released by the Red Sox amid poor performance.
Duran acknowledged struggling with his statistics, impacting his confidence and future with the team.
His situation highlights the pressure on local athletes and the Red Sox's roster decisions.

articles.title: Wu, Councilor Louijeune lead more than 100 elected officials in urging Congress to extend protections for Haitians
articles.description:
The officials call the Senate to pass a bill extending TPS for Haitians until early 2029.

The post Wu, Councilor Louijeune lead more than 100 elected officials in urging Congress to extend protections for Haitians appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Wu and Councilor Louijeune lead over 100 officials urging Congress to extend TPS for Haitians.
The proposed bill aims to extend protections until early 2029 for Haitian residents.
Local Haitian community members could benefit significantly from continued legal protections and stability.
